contactChange.description: Contact lifecycle events: ASSOCIATION (channel or named user linked to a contact), DISSOCIATION (unlinked), or UNINSTALL.

compliance.description: Compliance and registration events: email/SMS opt-in and opt-out, registrations, keyword flows, and related channel compliance signals (body.event_type).

emailOptOut.description: Email opt-out and registration signals from COMPLIANCE events on EMAIL channels (body.event_type=registration), split by registration_type (unsubscribe, open_tracking_opt_out, opt_out, opt_in, ...) and message_type (commercial vs transactional).

executiveSummary.text:
This audit connected to project "Demo Retail EU" using EARLIEST — manual stop (RTDS start=EARLIEST) with 5 RTDS event type(s) on the connect request: ATTRIBUTE_OPERATION, CUSTOM, SCREEN_VIEWED, SUBSCRIPTION_LIST, TAG_CHANGE. Device types on the request: all platforms (no device_types filter). The RTDS download was stopped manually after 0s; the NDJSON file was then analyzed.

The analyzed file contains 10,000 event(s) across 3 device type(s) in the sample (timezone for dates below: Europe/Paris). Device types observed: IOS (5,447, 54%); ANDROID (4,207, 42%); WEB (346, 3%). Occurred timestamps span 28 Jul 2026, 07:59 → 28 Jul 2026, 09:59 (~2 h). Processed timestamps in the download: 28 Jul 2026, 08:00 → 28 Jul 2026, 09:59 (1h 59m 59s between earliest and latest). With EARLIEST + manual stop, sample depth depends on how long the stream ran before Stop (historical backlog first).

9,593 unique channel(s) and 407 named user(s) contributed data.

Strongest platform: IOS (5,447 events, 54%).

Screen views: 2,907 across 8 screen name(s), top "home" (843).

Custom events (excl. email feedback): SDK 4,790 hit(s), top "product_viewed".

Attributes (excl. ua_*): 9 distinct key(s) in ATTRIBUTE_OPERATION events.

Tags (excl. ua_*): 591 added, 105 removed across 1 group(s) (1 with multiple tag values).
